instruction: Widen column A to make the paper titles fully visible without wrapping.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires widening column A to display 'QWEN TECHNICAL REPORT' fully. A minimum width of 25 characters should be sufficient. Default Excel column width is ~8.43, so this requires manual adjustment.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires 'without wrapping' but evaluator only checks column width, not text wrapping setting
Uncertain threshold adequacy: The min_width of 25.0 is based on 'QWEN TECHNICAL REPORT' but may not accommodate all paper titles in column A without verification of actual content

Missing verification logic: The evaluator cannot determine if titles are actually 'fully visible' - it only checks if width >= 25.0, which is an approximation rather than semantic verification of visibility
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification that text wrapping is disabled for column A (check cell format wrap_text property)
Either: (1) Verify the actual longest title in the file and set min_width accordingly, or (2) Add getter to check if any cells in column A have wrapped text
Consider checking that all cell values in column A fit within the column width without truncation or wrapping
